conbody.p: AI systems are connected to the internet and are unreliable when it comes to data security. If anything is connected to the internet that means that the information put in there is in fact discoverable by threat actors. This makes it even more important to ensure that you do not share confidential information with AI. Always de-identify information before adding it AI to ensure that information cannot be traced back to the discussed party.
AI pulls from a lot of different places on the internet, meaning that it really is not completely accurate all the time. Ensure that you fact check any data that you use from AI.

Threat Actors also have access to AI and they use it to enhance their own tools. This includes things like phishing attempts of OSINT reconnaissance. This means that you need to be skeptical of communications. Always independently confirm communications come from a trusted source to avoid scams. These can include voice calls, video calls. If you hear a loved one its not always them, so if you get an urgent message especially ones that request money, independently confirm that the request is legitimate.
